text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hussein says Jordan is force of strength for Arab nation; says Moslem Brotherhood part of regime and "are dear brothers and free to either boycott or participate in national elections," due in November.

- King tells Jordanians during tour of Tafila that dialogue "cannot be with one group but with everyone"; has full confidence in government and says parliament will soon be dissolved to prepare for elections.
- King says opposition parties "do not even number 1,000 people" in their enlisted ranks.
- King derides opposition parties and says "their voices higher than their actual strength".
- King calls on citizens to exercise rights in free and fair elections.
